descriptions.w3d_d26a_entry_scaled_value_8000b344: Reads entry index from table 0x804aa750; clamps v to the entry limit (+28) and the global minimum (+84 of 0x804aa6d8); when t is non-zero, unclamped and +64 is clear, moves v towards the limit by rate*t and multiplies the factor by rate*t+1. Returns factor * v * entry scale (+12).
